known_limitations: The closed feature owner computes each band's twenty-close SMA and population standard deviation (ddof=0), with width two deviations; both consecutive windows must have positive width.

BUY requires the previous close strictly below its own lower band, the current close strictly inside its own bands and a higher current close; SELL mirrors this across the upper band. A band touch, continuing outside close or widening-band recapture with no inward price movement does not qualify.

This additional confirmation vetoes an existing same-direction strategy signal only after the current bar closes. It creates no BUY/SELL direction and changes no quotes, cost accounting, sizing, risk caps or exit owner.

The range/session/volatility context and exact thresholds are prospective lab hypotheses. This is not Bollinger's complete W-bottom/M-top method or an independently qualified reversal skill. The old construction-only mean-reversion declaration remains unchanged.
